title: Place research travels one way between deployments: only allow-listed published rows cross the ingest door, imports are idempotent, pictures live in the shared bucket under content keys, and old pictures are re-keyed only to their own bytes
steps: S1: a sender with the shared store stores a new place picture; shared keys for Google and other sources.
S2: push a researched place from a sender database to a destination database through the real ingest door.
S3: send the same place again, three at once, and an origin snapshot already imported.
S4: call the door unconfigured, with a wrong secret, and with a body too large.
S5: configure the shared bucket with fewer than four settings; set the ingest secret on a shard.
S6: dry run and real move of old pictures into an in-memory shared bucket; change object_key to a key naming other bytes.
expect: S1: the key is media/google|other/<sha[0:2]>/<sha>.<ext>, naming the content and not the place.
S2: no account or opportunity data leaves the sender; the destination writes only allow-listed tables; pictures load there with the sender's store off.
S3: one place and one snapshot; the imported snapshot is not imported twice.
S4: 404 before the body is read when unconfigured or the secret is wrong; 413 when too large.
S5: refused, with no fallback to the artifact store; a shard with the ingest secret is refused.
S6: the dry run writes nothing; the move copies, verifies and re-keys, skips missing and mismatched sources, reruns and rolls back; the guard refuses a key for other bytes.
fence: the ingest door's secret check and allow-list, wo_place_snapshot_import's unique origin snapshot, placeMediaStore's prefix routing, config's no-fallback and shard refusal, wo_place_media_guard's same-bytes rekey

tests: the sender stores new place pictures under content-addressed shared keys
1. no account data leaves the sender and the destination writes only the allow-listed tables
1b. the importer source writes no table outside its allow-list
2. ingest is idempotent: sent again, or three at once, it is one place and one snapshot
2b. a snapshot already imported from this origin is never imported twice
3. pictures load on the destination with the sender store switched off; a stranger is refused
4. the door: 404 unconfigured or wrong secret before the body is read, 413 when too large
5. a missing or wrong object publishes nothing
a shared key names the content, not the place, and its origin prefix
the shared place media bucket needs its own four settings, with no fallback to the artifact store
the ingest secret is read on the master, refused when malformed, and refused on a shard
dry run counts rows, bytes, unstored and missing sources, and writes nothing
move copies, verifies and re-keys; skips missing and mismatched sources; reruns; rolls back
the guard still refuses a key that names other bytes
